name: goose
label: Goose
install: curl -fsSL https://github.com/aaif-goose/goose/releases/download/stable/goose-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.bz2 -o /tmp/goose.tar.bz2 && mkdir -p /tmp/goose-extract && tar -xjf /tmp/goose.tar.bz2 -C /tmp/goose-extract && mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" && install -m 0755 "$(find /tmp/goose-extract -type f -name goose | head -1)" "$HOME/.local/bin/goose"
